interface.name: hyprion_grade_manager_v1

description.summary: create compositor-side colour grades for a surface

interface.description:
Hyprion draws a sampled colour grade in the compositor, using the same framebuffer source as its window effects. The client supplies only an area and a style; no pixels cross the protocol.
Grades are surface-local and clipped to the surface that owns them. The capabilities event describes the area and mode bits this compositor implements. Pixels are always sampled from the framebuffer after the surface has been drawn; blur is requested separately through ext-background-effect-v1.

request.name: get_grade

description.summary: create a grade object for a surface

request.description: Multiple grade objects may be attached to the same surface. They are rendered in creation order.

interface.name: hyprion_grade_v1
interface.description: Coordinates are surface-local logical pixels. The box is the graded area; the area selects inset, outset, both, or fill. The grade is clipped to the owning surface and never paints outside it.

entry.name: in_place
entry.summary: apply the grade to the sampled pixels in place; alpha is preserved

entry.name: over
entry.summary: premultiplied source-over of the graded sample with coverage opacity

entry.name: unsupported
entry.summary: the requested area or mode is not implemented

entry.name: invalid_gradient
entry.summary: the gradient is empty or too large

description.summary: whether this surface can carry a compositor grade

arg.name: supported
arg.summary: 1 when the surface role is supported

request.name: set_mode

description.summary: select how the graded sample is written

request.description: in_place applies the grade to the sampled pixels and preserves their alpha. over composites the graded sample over the framebuffer using premultiplied source-over with the band's coverage as source alpha.

request.name: set_style
request.description: The transform uses OKLab on SDR framebuffers and Jzazbz on HDR framebuffers. lightness, saturation, chroma and hue are expressed in that grade space. On HDR, lightness is normalised to the 80-nit SDR reference white so the same numeric offset gives a comparable lift. colorize_strength blends the sample's chroma toward the target gradient. opacity is band coverage.

request.name: set_colorize_gradient
request.description: Colors are sRGB ARGB values, uniformly spaced. angle is in degrees. A single colour is a one-stop gradient. At most 10 stops are accepted.
